say: Alisson's contract runs out at the end of the season, and there are doubts he'll sign a new one. So how do Liverpool replace him?
cap: ALISSON'S CONTRACT RUNS OUT AT THE END OF THE SEASON, AND THERE ARE DOUBTS HE'LL SIGN A NEW ONE. SO HOW DO LIVERPOOL REPLACE HIM?

say: We compared him with all 131 goalkeepers in Europe's top five leagues.
cap: WE COMPARED HIM WITH ALL 131 GOALKEEPERS IN EUROPE'S TOP FIVE LEAGUES.

say: First, the keeper they already have: Giorgi Mamardashvili. He's twenty-six, a seventy-eight percent match, and worth thirty-six million euros. He's barely played for Liverpool, so we used his last full season, at Valencia. Only sixty-four percent of his passes found a teammate. Alisson managed seventy-nine. For Liverpool, that's not good enough.
